2122513816529318334.en_summary: $2 trillion gone in six weeks. $NVDA closed at $156.14 today, down 4% and 36% off October highs, now just above 154 key level that capped rallies in 2024-2025. Earnings tomorrow after close against $108B guide and ~$109B consensus, no Jensen on the call. Discusses three scenarios around Huang removal: return leads to violent reclamation (165 to $4T, 186 test, 207 to $5T); other CEO grind between 154-186 or drop to 104.89; Huang starts elsewhere fails 154 to 124/$3T and 104.89. Tomorrow's print sets floor, board statement sets ceiling. Watch 154.
